title: Coding agent status
description: What a coding agent reports when its session ends. The runner checks the claim against git before believing it.

status.description: done: every acceptance criterion is met, tests pass, work is committed and pushed. blocked_by_issue: another area must change first (fill new_issue). needs_owner: a PRD TBD or a product decision is needed (fill question). no_change: the criteria are already met on main and nothing needs to change. failed: you could not finish; explain in summary.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what changed and why, or why you stopped.

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion, in order.

how_verified.description: The test name or command that proves it, e.g. 'TestTickRate in server/internal/world/tick_test.go'.

tests_run.description: Commands you ran and whether they passed.

open_questions.description: Placeholders or assumptions the owner should know about. Not for blocking decisions.

new_issue.description: Only with blocked_by_issue: the change another area must make first.

question.description: Only with needs_owner: the decision the owner must make.
